purpose: Lock the deterministic midsummer Japanese solar sample and all shadow-map settings through generated-scene rebuilds and immediately before MainCamera rendering. This contract prevents a previously validated shadow state from being silently reset by a later solar/environment pass. It awards no Visual Fidelity points without actual rendered evidence.

solarDatum.expectedShadowHorizontalDirection: northeast, opposite the southwest sun azimuth
solarDatum.interpretation: At this deterministic sample, a 1.0 m vertical feature should cast approximately 0.622 m of horizontal geometric shadow before penumbra/contact effects. This is a source-math invariant, not rendered evidence.

rebuildCoupling.reason: QualityBlockWeatheringUpgrade and QualityBlockEnvironmentLightingUpgrade both reapply SummerSun during a fresh generated-scene build. Therefore applying only direction/intensity is insufficient; the complete stable shadow state must be reapplied at the same entry point.
rebuildCoupling.previousFailureMode: A pre-rebuild shadow QA could validate lightBias=0.025 and lightNormalBias=0.38, after which the environment context reapplied older 0.04/0.28 values before the native-4K render path.
rebuildCoupling.requiredBehavior: Every solar reapplication restores the complete shadow/camera/LOD stability state before the scene can be captured.

renderEvidencePlan.hero: Inspect building and ground shadows together. Shadow bearing must be consistent with a southwest sun and must not reverse between unrelated objects.
renderEvidencePlan.oblique: Inspect contact separation at balcony, park furniture and path/curb interfaces. Reject peter-panning or acne large enough to read at native 4K.
renderEvidencePlan.grazing: Inspect long thin-geometry and foliage shadows for stable penumbra direction, coherent highlight direction and absence of contradictory second-key cues.
renderEvidencePlan.temporal: Inspect camera movement for cascade swimming, shadow shimmer, abrupt LOD-shadow changes or aliasing. Source settings alone cannot clear these defects.

verification.note: Implementation/readiness metadata only. The calculated solar angles and shadow ratio validate source math, not image quality.
